What it does

Otter records site meetings and client calls, producing a searchable transcript and a summary afterwards. It is valuable when a conversation covers more than anyone can write down, and when you later need to establish exactly what was agreed. Background noise on site reduces accuracy, so it works best for meetings rather than while work is underway.

Where the AI actually is

Speech-to-text with automatic summaries and action items.

Pros

  • Accurate enough for practical use
  • Searchable transcripts
  • Free tier for light use

Cons

  • Struggles in noisy site environments

Who it suits

Built with General contractors, Remodelers & carpenters, Roofers in mind. Site meetings and client calls where you cannot take notes.
